uses.finding: The 1898 Coptic Catholic synod (Rome 1899; Bonn 324533) prescribes the Euchologium seu Missale with three anaphoras and the incense offices, conformity of editions to ancient and Apostolic-See-approved exemplars, a printed exemplar at every celebration and adoration rubrics at the consecration and the Spirit invocation; recognized 1 May 1899.
uses.limit: Does not name or describe the 1898 printing or the intercession relocation.
uses.next_sources: The 1898 book itself (Coptic Catholic Patriarchate holdings, Vatican/PIO, WorldCat holders).

uses.finding: Archival study of the 1901 Chaldean missal: Anglican Urmia missal of 1890; 1767 consecration at the start of the fraction and omission of the second and third anaphoras; Propaganda printing without approval; publication 1902; Audo's Urmia 1906 missal; 1936 reprint.
uses.limit: Archive mediated by the article; 1890-1902 only.

uses.finding: Propaganda withdrew the Chaldean missal project from Paul Bedjan on 24 March 1890; he no longer dealt with liturgical books; the 1767 missal held only the first liturgy.
uses.limit: Not a list of all Urmia imprints.

uses.finding: Thomas Audo's Urmia 1906 missal: approbation leaf attesting collation with Rome 1767, Apostolic Delegate's nihil obstat, preface on integrated Epistles, Gospels and proper chants and on the 1767 ordinary used at Urmia and Salmas.
uses.limit: Body not read or collated; approbation undated.
uses.next_sources: Body pages of Bonn 3058506 against 1767 and 1901.

uses.finding: Mercer p. 146 describes the Rome 1548 text as made for the Uniates (Monophysite names omitted, Filioque added, Invocation altered); p. 148 says Abyssinian Uniates possessed printed books by 1915.
uses.limit: No folio loci; not checked on the 1548 pages.

versions.label: Missale Chaldaicum, Urmia 1906 (Thomas Audo)
versions.distinctness_basis: Primary preface: Sunday and feast Epistles, Gospels and proper chants integrated into the missal for the first time locally; ordinary declared to be the Rome 1767 one as followed at Urmia and Salmas, declining the unfixed Mesopotamian deviations; Delly (p. 170) reads the book as opposition to the 1901 Mosul missal.

versions.label: Patriarch Elias XII Abolionan's missal lithographed in Egypt
versions.distinctness_basis: Delly reports its use in principal churches and the bishops' 1894 corrections to it.
versions.unresolved: No copy known; not authorized by Propaganda.

versions.label: Coptic Catholic Pascha (Holy Week) book sealed under Patriarch Kyrillos II
versions.distinctness_basis: Not a Eucharistic book; recorded only to bound the Bonn search.

versions.label: Lyturgia Armena + Ministerium Missae, continuously paginated 50-page impression with 1677 imprint
versions.distinctness_basis: Bibliography 1512-1800 entry 104 (collation and type area differ from entry 103); not a textual state
versions.unresolved: No copy inspected; printer and date of the later printing unverified.

versions.label: Qozhaya printing with appended daily Gospel selections
versions.distinctness_basis: Appended daily Gospel lectionary and changed start of the liturgical year (Gemayel pp. 57-58); reprints not counted.
versions.unresolved: No copy seen; first appearance within the four printings not paged.

versions.label: Unofficial practical edition in Arabic script
versions.distinctness_basis: Rubrics abridged, prayers deleted, feast psalms added, calendar removed (Gemayel pp. 63-64).
versions.unresolved: Book unseen; no approval act; candidate remains deferred.

versions.label: Sharfeh 1905 minister's book (Kitab khidmat al-quddas)
versions.distinctness_basis: Editor's preface states text re-established on old manuscripts, Arabic restricted to five public texts, a new second part of variable chants and appended Arabic fraction hymns.
versions.unresolved: Predecessor (Beirut 1884 (pencil note) or 1888 (Brightman) or Mosul 1881) and body collation.

versions.label: Malankara reunion reception of the Syriac Catholic missal
versions.date_label: September 1930 Mass (day before the 22 September letter); 4-5 July 1930 decision as context
versions.distinctness_basis: Dated reception and retention decision in documentary edition.

versions.label: Alwaye 1960 Syriac Taksa as bound in the 1962 book
versions.distinctness_basis: Own title leaf and imprimatur; witnesses the 1960 text, not a new state.

limits: The nine dossiers held 55 gap rows at the base; all are dispositioned. Work was split between the lane coordinator (Alexandrian, Chaldean, shared files) and four research helpers (Armenian; Maronite; Malabar and West Syriac; Byzantine, Blaj and Slavonic-Roman) whose dossier edits and inventory proposals were reviewed, spot-checked on page images and integrated by the coordinator. archive.org was reachable this batch (unlike batch 4); Google Books (API 429, page images refused), HathiTrust search and babel, Gallica, tert.nla.am and the ULB Bonn HTML/search pages (browser verification) refused scripted access and were not circumvented; Bonn's public IIIF and OAI endpoints were used. OCR and text layers served only as finding aids; every positive claim rests on page images or inspected primary/scholarly loci. No stage text fields were changed; byzantine greek1738/1754/1873 are untouched. All new stages are not-transcribed. Acquired bytes stay in lane scratch with SHA-256 receipts; derived renders are not acquisitions. A usage-limit interruption paused the work once; the Armenian and Byzantine helpers were resumed with their context and did not redo logged work.
